origin: OpenCode 1.18.16: two tool calls in one answer, and the two results the client sends back in one turn (Claude Code writes them in the reverse order). The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and reasoning_effort is the medium OpenCode sends for it (its verbosity field is left out, see extra-opencode-gpt-request-with-verbosity). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
